packages.label: XO package
packages.description: The Weeknd concert, Bangkok-Phuket internal flight, six nights, listed meals, transfers and the included experiences on the next page.

packages.label: Starboy package
packages.description: Everything in XO, plus international flights and all itinerary activities. The exclusions listed on the next page apply only to XO, not Starboy.

exclusionsNote: Exclusions apply to the XO package only. The Starboy package is all-inclusive, including international flights and all itinerary activities.
optionalNote: Activities marked optional in the itinerary are optional extras for XO. They are included in the Starboy package.
